canonical_project: Doma Infrastructure Group Chachoengsao Data Center Park
owner: Doma Infrastructure Group + Silicon Tech Park (STP)
notes: Chachoengsao is one of three provinces hosting Doma/STP AI-ready green data centre parks (300 acres combined, 1.5 GW total across Chachoengsao, Chonburi, Rayong); first phase Q3 2026. TNW also notes Chachoengsao has become Thailand's primary data-centre cluster with earlier hyperscaler approvals (AWS, Google, NextDC, CtrlS, GDS reported).
